description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface, which declares asynchronous methods for retrieving catalog items, brands, and types for use in the web application's catalog view model.

classes.name: ICatalogViewModelService
classes.description: An interface providing asynchronous methods for fetching catalog data and selection lists for brand and type filters.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of catalog items, filtered optionally by brand and type identifiers.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of brands as select list items.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of catalog types as select list items.
